title: Robert Saleh: Removing all seed oils from the Titans' facility was a top priority

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh: Removing all seed oils from the Titans' facility was a top priority
sources.description: New Titans head coach Robert Saleh made an immediate change in Tennessee when he got the job four months ago: He ensured that players wouldn't eat seed oils at the team facility.
